summary: Content-overhaul verification for Bernat Solutions. Backend regression suite (15/15) still passes + new test test_new_processes.py confirms the new process values ('Tube / section laser cutting', 'Waterjet cutting', 'Flame cutting', 'Bevel cutting / weld prep') are accepted by POST /api/quotes as a comma-separated list, persisted as an array, and returned via GET /api/admin/quotes. Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright: nav-logo + favicon, all 13 home sections, 4 capability groups, 16 material chips, 19 capability items, 16 materials list, 19 marquee items, positioning copy (both required phrases present + all forbidden 'we own machines' phrases absent), 5 new service cards + 5 detail pages with supplier-network alt text and 'Representative supplier-network image' overlay, quote form with all 20 process chip testids + 15 material select options + fancy-apostrophe copy + file-format sidebar copy, full quote submission (3 chips inc. the new ones, consent, submit → quote-success q_ id), About page copy correct, Footer includes 'supplier network' + all 5 new capability slug links, Admin dashboard renders with alex@bernatsolutions.com, quotes table populated, drawer opens showing expanded processes list. Total: 16/16 backend and 100/100 material frontend assertions pass. The three UI 'FAIL' lines in raw script output are all CSS text-transform:uppercase false negatives (script used innerText which returns the RENDERED uppercase; re-run using textContent shows all text is present — visible in screenshots).

issues: Persistent whitespace issue from iteration_1 — DOM text is 'Steel, Laser Cutting& Fabrication Withoutthe Usual Hassle.' (missing space before '&' and between 'Without' and 'the'). Screen-reader aria-label is correct, but the split-line JSX in Hero.jsx joins lines without leading/trailing spaces. Cosmetic; assertions still pass because required substrings ('Steel, Laser Cutting', '& Fabrication', 'Without', 'Usual Hassle') are individually present.
Persistent from iteration_1 — /api/auth/me returns 401 for anonymous visitors and shows as a red console error on every public page. Consider swallowing 401 in AuthProvider.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Fix the missing whitespace in the Home hero H1 so the rendered DOM reads 'Steel, Laser Cutting & Fabrication Without the Usual Hassle.' — insert a leading space in the JSX children of lines 2 and 3 of RevealLines in /app/frontend/src/components/Hero.jsx.
(Optional) Swallow 401 from /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors in AuthProvider so public pages don't spam the browser console.
critical_code_review_comments: Positioning content is now consistent — no 'our machines / our factory / we manufacture everything in-house / we operate 24/7 / our laser cutting machines' phrases anywhere on Home or About; wording is correctly 'source and manage … through a trusted supplier network'.
Service detail images all carry '-- representative supplier-network capability image' in alt text and an on-image 'Representative supplier-network image' overlay label — good positioning disclosure.

Old service slugs (/services/folding-press-brake, /services/welding-fabrication, /services/finishing, /services/steel-supply) correctly redirect to /services — not re-tested here per main agent's instruction.
Marquee font size (7vw) fits all 19 items cleanly on desktop; band remains visually balanced.

Nothing structural changed in the backend — server.py continues to accept multipart quote submissions, splits `processes` on comma, and stores as list. The full lifecycle (submit → admin list → admin detail → download file → patch status → delete → 404) still passes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (material assertions all pass — cross-verified via textContent + screenshots)

test_credentials: Admin: session_token='test_session_admin_bernat' → alex@bernatsolutions.com. Non-admin: session_token='test_session_nonadmin' → random@example.com. Both seeded via mongosh into test_database.users + test_database.user_sessions before pytest run.
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded admin+non-admin sessions from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Playwright submitted one TEST_Playwright quote (id q_15d467304c60) end-to-end which was then cleaned up via DELETE /api/admin/quotes/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported before running pytest (not auto-loaded by the FastAPI backend .env). Admin/non-admin session tokens must be re-seeded via mongosh before tests. Use textContent (not innerText) when asserting page copy — several headings use CSS text-transform:uppercase and innerText will falsely-negatively differ from the source case. New capability of value is validated by test_new_processes.py which posts a real quote with 4 new process values and verifies the persisted list via admin detail endpoint.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional regressions. Two carry-over cosmetic items from iteration_1 (hero whitespace + /auth/me 401 console noise) remain.
